name: bahamas-vat
description: Bahamas value added tax (VAT) for 2026. Covers who must register (taxable activity over BSD 100,000 in a past or future 12 months), the 10% standard rate, the 5% reduced rate on listed medical goods, the exemption from 1 April 2026 for listed unprepared food sold by a food store, zero rating, VAT on conveyances of real property (Third Schedule bands, first home cap raised to BSD 600,000 from 1 July 2026), input VAT, refunds, VAT withholding by government entities, return periods and the 21-day filing rule, and the late filing and late payment fines. Trigger on Bahamas VAT, DIR VAT return, vat.revenue.gov.bs, food store VAT exemption, provisional VAT invoice, Bahamas VAT registration. The Bahamas has no income tax. Built from the VAT Act and the Department of Inland Revenue; not reviewed by an accountant.
